error_handling.overview: Common error scenarios in OSI data modeling and their resolutions.

error_scenario.name: Schema Validation Failure
error_scenario.description: The OSI validator reports schema errors when the YAML does not conform to the OSI JSON schema (osi-schema.json).

common_causes.cause: Invalid dialect values (must be from enum: ANSI_SQL, SNOWFLAKE, MDX, TABLEAU, DATABRICKS)
Incorrect data types (e.g., string instead of array for datasets)

error_scenario.resolution: Run the validator: python3 validation/validate.py [model_file] Fix each reported error by checking the path and message. Refer to core-spec/osi-schema.json for the exact schema definition.

error_scenario.name: Duplicate Name Error
error_scenario.description: The validator reports duplicate names within datasets, fields, metrics, or relationships.

common_causes.cause: Two datasets with the same name in one model
Two fields with the same name within one dataset
Two metrics with the same name in one model

error_scenario.resolution: Rename the duplicate entity to a unique name. Use the dataset name as a prefix if needed (e.g., orders_order_id vs order_id).

error_scenario.name: Invalid Reference Error
error_scenario.description: A relationship references a dataset that does not exist in the model.

common_causes.cause: Typo in the from or to field of a relationship
Dataset was renamed but relationship was not updated
Dataset exists in a different model but not in the current one

error_scenario.resolution: Verify all dataset names in the model. Update the relationship from/to fields to match existing dataset names exactly.

error_scenario.name: SQL Syntax Error
error_scenario.description: The validator reports invalid SQL syntax in field or metric expressions. This check requires sqlglot to be installed.

common_causes.cause: Typo in column name within expression

error_scenario.resolution: Install sqlglot for validation: pip install sqlglot Test the expression in the target SQL dialect. For complex expressions, validate incrementally (test sub-expressions first).

error_scenario.name: Missing Time Dimension Flag
error_scenario.description: Not a validation error, but a quality issue: date columns are not marked with is_time: true.
error_scenario.impact: AI tools cannot automatically apply time-based operations (date truncation, rolling windows) without the is_time flag.
error_scenario.resolution: Review all date/datetime columns and set dimension.is_time: true. Do NOT set is_time: true for foreign keys to date tables (e.g., sold_date_sk).

error_scenario.name: Relationship Column Mismatch
error_scenario.description: Relationship from_columns or to_columns reference columns that do not exist in the respective datasets.
error_scenario.impact: Join path resolution fails, preventing cross-dataset metrics and AI query generation.
error_scenario.resolution: Verify each column in from_columns exists in the from dataset's fields. Verify each column in to_columns exists in the to dataset's fields. Ensure the column order matches between from_columns and to_columns.

error_scenario.name: Version Mismatch
error_scenario.description: The model file specifies a version that does not match the current OSI specification.
error_scenario.resolution: Update the version header to match the current specification: version: "0.1.1" Check core-spec/spec.yaml for the latest version.

recovery_protocol.step: Run the validator and collect all errors
Fix schema errors first (missing fields, invalid types)
Fix reference errors (relationships pointing to missing datasets)
Fix SQL syntax errors in expressions
Re-run validator to confirm all errors are resolved
Perform manual review for quality issues (time dimensions, ai_context)
